theme_and_archetype.domain: Finance, Accounting, Taxation, ERP for Indian MSMEs
theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) infused with Indian Fintech Trust
theme_and_archetype.rationale: A highly functional, precise, and authoritative design. It replaces chaotic handwritten ledgers with clear, high-contrast digital truth. Avoiding purple gradients; instead relying on Deep Emerald (growth/money) and crisp Obsidian/White for maximum data density without clutter.

typography.notes: JetBrains Mono MUST be used for all financial figures (amounts, GSTINs, PAN numbers, inventory counts) to ensure tabular alignment and numerical clarity.

rules.primary_usage: Use Emerald/Green variants ONLY for primary CTAs, positive financial balances, and active states. Do NOT overuse.
rules.accent_usage: Use Terracotta/Orange for outstanding payables, low-stock alerts, and secondary actionable highlights.
rules.neutral_tint: Greys must be slightly tinted with cool blue (Zinc scale) to feel precise and financial.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Financial figures right-aligned. Labels left-aligned. Center alignment is BANNED except for empty states or explicit modals.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px solid border (border-border). Max border-radius: rounded-lg. No heavy shadows, use shadow-sm on hover.
surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Restricted to sticky headers and modal overlays. High opacity (bg-white/80 or bg-black/80) with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px inner border.
surface_strategies.tables: Zebra striping on dense financial ledgers (bg-transparent odd:bg-surface-hover/50) to aid scanning.

motion_and_interactions.kpi_card_reveal: Staggered entrance: opacity 0 to 1, translateY 10px to 0px, duration 0.3s, stagger 0.05s.
motion_and_interactions.tabular_data_hover: Row hover highlight: background shifts to subtle gray/zinc tint, left border highlight (inset box-shadow 3px 0 0 brand_primary) to anchor the eye across wide tables.
motion_and_interactions.sidebar_expand: Smooth width transition (w-16 to w-64) via framer-motion layout animation. Icons remain static, labels fade in (opacity 0 to 1, delay 0.1s).
motion_and_interactions.button_click: Scale down to 0.97, swift recovery. Hover state must explicitly define higher contrast background and text.

components_guidelines.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-md). High contrast. No gradients.
components_guidelines.navigation: Sidebar for dashboard, top sticky nav for marketing page.
components_guidelines.forms: Use Shadcn inputs. Labels must be bold. Input focus state must be a sharp 2px ring of brand_primary (ring-2 ring-brand ring-offset-1).
components_guidelines.charts: Recharts. Use monochromatic fills with brand accents. Tooltips must have dark background and crisp white text. Remove grid lines except horizontal base lines.

iconography.style: Duotone weight for marketing, Regular weight for dense dashboard interfaces.

hero_and_marketing.description: Indian shop owner standing proudly, representing MSME target audience.
hero_and_marketing.placement: Marketing landing page feature section or about section.

hero_and_marketing.description: Close-up of financial graphs and charts.
hero_and_marketing.placement: Hero section background image (with heavy dark/glass overlay) or dashboard illustration.

avatars_and_testimonials.placement: Testimonial avatar 1 (e.g., CA or large distributor).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard Inter/Roboto. You MUST import and use Outfit (Headings), IBM Plex Sans (Body), and JetBrains Mono (Data).
CRITICAL: All financial data, tables, invoice amounts, and GSTIN numbers MUST use JetBrains Mono (font-mono).
CRITICAL: Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs) for testing.
CRITICAL: Ensure both light and dark modes are fully supported. Avoid arbitrary hex colors in components; strictly rely on the configured Tailwind semantic variables.
CRITICAL: Never use placeholder images. Use ONLY the URLs provided in the image_assets section.
CRITICAL: Format Indian Currency correctly (₹). Use appropriate commas (e.g., 1,50,000 not 150,000).
